connector.name: OpenGrok MCP Server by IcyHot09 (icyhot09-opengrok-mcp-server)
connector.registryDescription: MCP server bridging OpenGrok search engine with AI for instant context across massive codebases.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package opengrok-mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the icyhot09 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: OPENGROK_PASSWORD
env.description: OpenGrok authentication password. Prefer storing via OS keychain using 'npx opengrok-mcp-server setup'.

env.name: OPENGROK_VERIFY_SSL
env.description: Verify TLS certificates. Set to false for self-signed or internal CA certs.

env.name: OPENGROK_CODE_MODE
env.description: Enable Code Mode: 5-tool sandbox interface with env.opengrok.* JavaScript API. Saves 80-95% tokens on large codebases.

env.name: OPENGROK_DEFAULT_PROJECT
env.description: Default project to scope all searches. Can be overridden per call.

env.name: OPENGROK_CONTEXT_BUDGET
env.description: Response size tier controlling token usage.

env.name: OPENGROK_ENABLE_ELICITATION
env.description: Enable interactive project picker at session start and env.opengrok.elicit() in Code Mode sandbox. Requires a supporting MCP client.

env.name: OPENGROK_SAMPLING_MODEL
env.description: Model preference for MCP Sampling (used for error explanation and query reformulation).
